low.title: Low-Budget Half-Day Hallstatt History Walk
low.summary: A simple, affordable historical route covering Hallstatt’s iconic spots, ancient heritage, and peaceful lakeside views.

schedule.title: Lakefront Historical Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start by the water where the village’s origins began — trade routes, boats, and early settlement vibes.

schedule.title: Old Town Wooden Architecture
schedule.description: Wander through traditional wooden houses and steep alleys that reflect centuries of alpine living.

schedule.title: Budget Snack Break
schedule.description: Grab a simple pastry or roll before continuing your mini historical journey.

schedule.title: Church & Cemetery Viewpoint
schedule.description: A classic historical spot with one of the best viewpoints over the lake — iconic and peaceful.

schedule.title: Lakeside Path Finish
schedule.description: End with a calm walk along the water where trade and early culture once thrived.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Hallstatt History Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable journey through Hallstatt's heritage — museum highlights, historic streets, and mid-range food.

schedule.title: Café Start + Historical Overview
schedule.description: Begin with a light drink while absorbing the views of a village settled thousands of years ago.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Museum – Cultural Origins
schedule.description: Explore archaeological findings, early tools, and artifacts from the Hallstatt culture.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A well-priced Austrian meal before walking the historical streets.

schedule.title: Heritage Architecture Walk
schedule.description: See centuries-old wooden homes and classic alpine building techniques.

schedule.title: Lakefront Historical Reflection
schedule.description: Finish with views that shaped Hallstatt’s trading history.

high.title: High-End Hallstatt Historical Highlights
high.summary: A premium-feel half-day history route with curated exhibits, elegant architecture, and refined dining.

schedule.title: Scenic Historical Breakfast
schedule.description: Enjoy a beautiful breakfast while learning about Hallstatt’s ancient settlement.

schedule.title: Curated Museum Visit
schedule.description: Examine well-preserved artifacts, early Celtic cultural influences, and detailed displays.

schedule.title: High-Quality Austrian Lunch
schedule.description: A refined dish with local alpine ingredients and historical culinary roots.

schedule.title: Historic Upper Village Walk
schedule.description: Explore elevated paths showing old mining entrances and traditional alpine layouts.

schedule.title: Premium Lakeside Ending
schedule.description: Finish at a photogenic point where history and nature blend beautifully.

comfortable.title: Luxury Half-Day Hallstatt Heritage Journey
comfortable.summary: A curated, elegant history-focused route with fine dining, refined museum exploration, and iconic heritage viewpoints.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast + Historical Overview
schedule.description: Begin with top-tier morning dishes overlooking the ancient trading lake.

schedule.title: Guided or Curated Museum Heritage Tour
schedule.description: Explore artifacts and cultural stories with time to appreciate craftsmanship and early life.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Alpine Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy premium dishes inspired by centuries-old alpine culinary traditions.

schedule.title: Exclusive Architectural Heritage Walk
schedule.description: Visit the most iconic historic streets, steep pathways, and wooden structures.

schedule.title: Signature Lakefront Finale
schedule.description: End your heritage journey with a quiet viewpoint that perfectly frames Hallstatt’s history.
